priority_items.title: VMSA lodges Matui criminal complaint; Napuati wants Master arrested; family-list 53; confirmed SAR band unchanged
priority_items.summary: In-window Daily Post (16 Sep): VMSA complaint lodged with police Monday 14 Sep against captain, management and owners (Shipping Act s.42). Napuati requests Penal Code s.108 charges for unintentional death. Family/relative list 53 including crew is CLAIM, not a verified manifest. Confirmed still 2 dead / 14 survivors / ~30+ missing. Arrest requested, not confirmed. PENAMA police to protect owner family on Ambae. VFSC notices page still has no Tui extract; Daily Post adds 22 Jun Limited Partnership certification after 2 Jun business-name strike-off. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: China hands Vanuatu US$100k for Ambae volcanic response and MV Matui — modest grant, not a pact
priority_items.summary: In-window wire. Daily Post and RNZ (10:03 NZST 16 Sep / 22:03 UTC 15 Sep): US$100,000 (VT11m / ~NZ$155k) handed over 15 Sep afternoon in Port Vila by Ambassador Li Minggang to PM Napat. Reported split: VT4.6m Ambae drilling machine, VT4.4m Ambae relief goods, VT2.25m Matui response. Napat thanked Xi. Distinct from the earlier VT6.8bn earthquake reconstruction grant. Do not inflate into alignment shift or security presence. Not FLASH.
